name: weekday_successor
description: Name the weekday k days after a given weekday. Control: same template with integer successor.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
D=['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(7):
    for k in (1,2,3,4):
        w={1:'one day',2:'two days',3:'three days',4:'four days'}[k]
        items.append({'prompt':f'Question: What day of the week comes {w} after {D[i]}?\nAnswer:','answer':' '+D[(i+k)%7]})
        items.append({'prompt':f'If today is {D[i]}, then {k} day{"s" if k>1 else ""} from now it will be','answer':' '+D[(i+k)%7]})
for t in range(56):
    n=random.randint(5,60); k=random.choice([1,2,3,4])
    if t%2==0:
        w={1:'one',2:'two',3:'three',4:'four'}[k]
        control.append({'prompt':f'Question: What number comes {w} after {n}?\nAnswer:','answer':' '+str(n+k)})
    else:
        control.append({'prompt':f'If the counter is {n}, then {k} step{"s" if k>1 else ""} from now it will be','answer':' '+str(n+k)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
